lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The highest-intensity local maxima are arranged in at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with each column containing 3 to 5 roughly circular high-luminance clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal axis of the subject; the high-luminance blobs are precisely centered within these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant linear features run horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (light upper boundary, shadowed lower boundary).

other_distinctive_markers: A pectoral fin is visible in the lower central region, characterized by a high spatial density of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more numerous than the blobs on the lateral flank.
